data.narrative: Reproduced two race conditions this module: a loud duplicate-key failure and a silent stale-data failure. Rather than reproduce the canonical analytics-bucket bug verbatim (absent in the checkpoint fork), traced the same bug class to its real surfaces -- code generation (links.code) and the redirect cache -- and fixed both atomically.

dimension_scores.observation: Wrote testable hypotheses before touching code and tied each candidate (data/timing/concurrency) to a specific falsifying repro.
dimension_scores.evidence: Data/timing eliminated by construction; concurrency confirmed with a deterministic forced-identical-candidate repro yielding the exact duplicate-key message.

dimension_scores.observation: Used the module's log clue (duplicate key constraint) to infer the check-then-act window, and grepped server logs to confirm no constraint violations on the redirect path.
dimension_scores.evidence: Log grep for analytics_link_id_bucket_unique/duplicate key/IntegrityError returned no matches during concurrent redirect runs.

dimension_scores.observation: Produced minimal, single-variable repro scripts and made the flaky window deterministic by forcing the RNG.
dimension_scores.evidence: repro_race.py changes only concurrency; repro_code_race.py forces one variable (RNG) to make the race reproduce on demand; repro_cache_race.py fixes the interleaving explicitly.

dimension_scores.observation: Documented findings clearly with evidence files and structured proof summaries at each step.
Did not stop at the loud failure; audited the codebase for other SELECT-then-INSERT/lost-update surfaces and fixed the silent one (cache populate vs invalidate) with an atomic version token.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified and fixed the redirect-cache lost-update race that silently served stale URLs.

dimension_scores.observation: Explanation of impact and fix is solid; a formal blameless writeup with remediation owners would round it out.
dimension_scores.evidence: Evidence documents impact and root cause but no owner/checklist remediation structure.

strengths: Deterministic reproduction of a flaky race by forcing a single variable (RNG), turning 'it sometimes breaks' into 'it breaks every time I run this script'.
Audited beyond the reported symptom and found a second, silent lost-update race in the redirect cache, fixed with an atomic version token.
Made both fixes atomic at the database/Redis boundary (retry-on-IntegrityError, WATCH/MULTI conditional populate) rather than swallowing errors.
Locked both fixes with regression tests and reusable repro scripts suitable for CI.
growth_areas: Postmortem framing: no owner-backed remediation items or timeline were written for the two races.
The cache fix relies on an optimistic-concurrency WATCH loop; a pessimistic/atomic Lua equivalent would avoid the small retry window.
data.recommendation: Write a one-paragraph blameless postmortem for the silent cache race (impact, root cause, remediation, owner) to complete the incident-response picture before Module 4.

public_evidence.student_action: Reproduced a duplicate-key race under concurrency and changed code generation from SELECT-then-INSERT to insert-with-retry-on-IntegrityError.
public_evidence.technical_detail: links_service.create_link now retries with a fresh code on IntegrityError; unique constraint links_code_key arbitrates.
public_evidence.proof: repro_code_race.py: forced identical first candidate -> old code returned INTEGRITY duplicate key; fixed code returned two distinct codes.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves the candidate can find and eliminate check-then-act races in real code rather than copy a textbook upsert.

public_evidence.student_action: Found a silent lost-update race where a stale cache populate could land after invalidation, and fixed it with a per-code generation token.
public_evidence.technical_detail: invalidate INCRs redirect:ver:<code>; set captures version before DB read and conditionally populates via WATCH/MULTI; get rejects version-mismatched payloads.
public_evidence.proof: repro_cache_race.py: stale populate after invalidate previously served old URL; after fix GET /r served the new URL; test_stale_populate_after_invalidate_is_rejected passes.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates understanding that silent data corruption is prevented by making two writes behave as one atomic operation.
